task.description: Validate the CODE-DESIGNER Step 01 design for DDL-01, MIG-04, MIG-05, MIG-06 (stage 16). CODE-DESIGNER returned result.status PARTIAL with 3 flagged open questions (all explicitly marked by the designer as non-blocking, with a chosen interim resolution for each). Your job includes judging whether ORCH should accept each interim resolution as reasonable (in which case treat as PASS with notes) or whether one/more genuinely needs REQ-ANALYST clarification before BACKEND-DEV proceeds (in which case FAIL with that specific issue). The 3 questions: (1) MIG-05 AC5 migration-file-immutability enforcement -- designer chose option (b), pure process/tooling discipline, no runtime code -- assess if this is a defensible reading of MIG-05's other ACs and the existing migration_id free-text design. (2) MIG-06 AC2 'the migration set' registry -- designer proposes an interim caller-supplied known_migration_ids parameter to handleRunMigration -- assess if this genuinely satisfies AC2's observable behavior (404 UnknownMigration, no control rows written) without requiring DDL-01's not-yet-built CLI. (3) MIG-06's platform-operator role mapped to existing Role.PLATFORM_ADMIN -- assess if this is consistent with the requirement text and the rest of this batch/batch-0.
acceptance_criteria: Every AC in DDL-01, MIG-04, MIG-05, MIG-06 traced to a design section
No implementation code in the design
DDL-01 correctly composes ddl_namespace.checkNamespace() rather than re-deriving it
MIG-04/05/06 correctly extend migration_fanout.zig rather than redesigning it
Each of the 3 flagged open questions independently judged: accept the interim resolution, or FAIL with specific escalation need
